components.css: .ds-button { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 38px; padding: 8px 15px; border-radius: 7px; background: #1f3a8a; color: #fff; font: 650 12px/1.3 'Segoe UI', Arial, sans-serif; text-decoration: none; transition: background 150ms ease-out, transform 150ms ease-out; } .ds-button:hover { background: #172e70; transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #f59e0b; outline-offset: 3px; }

narrative.overview: A calm instrument for seeing relationships that individual company filings obscure. The interface uses hierarchy, alignment, and restrained color to move readers from sector overview to company evidence.
keyCharacteristics: Restrained blue accent for navigation, actions, and meaningful state

rules.name: The Signal Rule
rules.body: Observatory Blue marks action, selection, or meaningful analytical emphasis. It is not general decoration.

rules.name: The Evidence Hierarchy Rule
rules.body: A conclusion may be larger than its supporting details, but a decorative heading must never overpower the conclusion.

rules.name: The Flat-by-Default Rule
rules.body: Most surfaces rest on the canvas without a shadow. Depth communicates grouping or interaction.

dos: Lead with the latest conclusion and make source-backed detail easy to reach.
Use full dividers, background tones, and alignment to establish structure.
Keep company and period comparisons visually consistent.
donts: Do not resemble promotional corporate investor-relations sites.
Do not resemble generic SaaS dashboards built from interchangeable metric cards.
Do not resemble noisy trading terminals.
Do not use thick colored side stripes, wide decorative shadows, or default blue-to-purple gradients.
